content:
Jimmy Kimmel on Tuesday ripped President Donald Trump’s weekend event, billed as “the most exclusive dinner in the world,” meant to reward the top purchasers of the president’s meme coin.

After slamming the president for the millions he raked in after Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang was reinstated on Monday, Kimmel mocked some of the dinner’s guests.

“It was billed as ‘the most exclusive dinner in the world’ with guests Floyd Mayweather, Tristan Thompson and Kevin O’Leary from ‘Shark Tank.’ That’s not even the most exclusive episode of ‘Celebrity Rehab’ in the world,” Kimmel said.

Kimmel added that, since January 2025, Trump’s meme coin value has dropped 98%. Following Trump’s dinner on Sunday, CNBC reported that the coin’s value had dropped below $1 after reaching a high of $75 the day before Trump’s second inauguration, on Jan. 19, 2025.

Kimmel then showed a Chuck E. Cheese token as the “coin Trump is selling now.”

“It looks familiar. It’s, I don’t know. I’m thinking pizza when I see it. It’s so inspiring to see, even while he’s so busy knocking down the White House, botching the war, tanking the economy, still finds time to run a pyramid scheme out of his golf course,” Kimmel said.

According to a report from The Guardian, Trump told attendees at the dinner that he’s “doing it for the United States” and that if “we don’t do it, China’s going to do it.”
